newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares ease on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares ease on correction.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index eased on a correction on Wednesday due to profit-taking after recent strong gains, brokers said.
The B index inched down 0.32 points, or 0.19 percent, to close at 164.78, with turnover falling to HK$427.69 million from HK$659.39 million on Tuesday.

Brokers said profit-taking of shares that had seen sharp rises over the past few sessions dragged down the index but sentiment was still good. B shares appeared overbought after big gains for four successive sessions and today's retreat was normal, one broker said.
"I think the market is likely to move up through a short period of consolidation," one analyst said.
Guangdong Expressway was the biggest loser, down HK$0.40, or 4.55 percent, to HK$8.40 on thin volume of 235,500 shares due to profit-taking, brokers said.
Chiwan Wharf fell HK$0.25, or 3.53 percent, to HK$6.84, with 3.46 million shares traded.
Building materials maker Fangda lost HK$0.28, or 3.49 percent, to HK$7.75 on volume of 892,500 shares.
Floppy disk maker Benelux bucked the trend with a rise of HK$0.27, or 5.30 percent, to HK$5.36 after 460.030 million shares changed hands.
Changan Automobile, aided by institutional buying, added HK$0.06 to HK$5.05 on the session's heaviest trading volume of 8.54 million shares, brokers said.
China Bicycle edged up HK$0.03 to HK$4.28 on volume of 7.69 million shares, making it the second most active counter.
The A market rose on renewed buying from investors of Shenzhen counters, brokers said.

The A index rose 10.57 points, or 2.31 percent, to 468.89, with turnover expanding to 16.58 billion yuan from Tuesday's 8.99 billion. The composite index added 9.48 points, or 2.18 percent, to 443.63.
Buying was targeted at recently listed small-cap issues, brokers said.
Food processor Ruyi, the day's star, surged 3.00 yuan, or 17.49 percent, to 20.15 yuan. Textile issue Tianjin Meilun climbed 2.61 yuan, or 16.32 percent, to 18.60 yuan.
